card.name: Words before "difference" in group comparisons
card.fires_on: Words like "significant", "no" or "the" right before an expected "difference" or "differences" in trial result comparisons, often after "no statistically" or with placebo or drug groups.

modes.label: No significant difference
modes.description: "significant" or "no" in negated findings comparing a drug with placebo.

modes.label: The difference between groups
modes.description: "the" or part of "placebo" just before the word difference in group comparisons.
modes.example: at Week 52,<< the>> difference between groups was +1.7

modes.label: No change in tables
modes.description: "No" in interaction table keys where the next word is change or effect.

card.writes: It promotes "difference" and "differences" and suppresses words like "slightly" and "margin".
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say there was or wasn't a difference between treatment groups.
